page.overview:
What is Harlond?

Harlond (Sindarin for "south haven") was an Elf-haven and harbor on the northern shores of Harlindon, in the far western parts of Middle-earth.

The southern harbor on the Gulf of Lhûn was Harlond, its northern counterpart was Forlond, and the Grey Havens were to the east.

Sometime after the end of the First Age, the Elves on the southern shores of the newly formed Gulf of Lhûn built a haven there. Its northern counterpart was Forlond.

It is told that the fleet of Eärnur, arriving in Lindon during the Angmar War, filled the harbours of Harlond, Forlond, and the Grey Havens.
